newsitem.title: USA: Denver mayor diagnosed with prostate cancer.
newsitem.headline: Denver mayor diagnosed with prostate cancer.

text.p: Mayor Wellington Webb, 55, has been diagnosed with prostate cancer and will be operated on Monday, his office announced Sunday.
Webb, who has been busy with preparations for the upcoming G-7 meeting in Denver in June, will recuperate for several weeks, his press secretary Andrew Hudson said.
"But the mayor said after Denver International Airport, he doesn't want to set deadlines," Hudson quipped, referring to the delayed opening of the city's new airport two years ago.
Webb's duties during his convalescence will be taken over by the deputy mayor and other senior staffers.
